title: Vine Leaf Pie with Freekeh Filling
subtitle: a vegan showpiece
description: A vegan round pie of blanched vine leaves filled with freekeh, artichoke hearts, tomato and preserved lemon.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a pot and fry the chopped red onion until golden. Add the garlic and chopped tomatoes and stir. Add the freekeh (soaked in water for half an hour and drained), the dried mint, chopped preserved lemon, sliced artichoke hearts, chilli, salt, pepper and baharat and stir for 2 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease a 22-24 cm round tin with olive oil. Line the tin with half the vine leaves in an overlapping pattern, spoon in the filling and close over with the remaining vine leaves.
Brush the leaves with olive oil, cover with baking paper (tucking the edges between the vine leaves and the tin) and bake for 35 minutes.
About 5-7 minutes before the end of baking, remove the baking paper, brush the top with olive oil and continue baking until the pie browns and sets.
Cool for 20 minutes at room temperature before cutting. Slice with a sharp knife.
